body:
## User Story

As a JoeKnock system administrator,
I want geocoding requests controlled through the JoeKnock backend,
so that the application does not expose or abuse the external geocoding service.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Frontend does not call geocoding providers directly.
- [ ] MVP geocoding flow is mediated through `POST /api/properties/resolve`.
- [ ] Backend performs reverse geocoding as an internal implementation detail.
- [ ] Requests require authentication.
- [ ] Backend validates coordinates input.
- [ ] Geocoding/provider behavior is handled behind JoeKnock API boundaries.
- [ ] OpenStreetMap attribution requirements are supported by the application.

## Technical Notes

- Public geocoding endpoints are not exposed in MVP.
- Geocoding provider calls remain internal to backend property resolution.
- Representatives do not manually edit latitude or longitude.

## Related database tables

- properties

## Related API endpoints

- POST /api/properties/resolve

## Related ADRs

- ADR-012: Organization Data Isolation
- ADR-016: OpenStreetMap Nominatim for MVP Geocoding

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are implemented and verified.
- [ ] Geocoding access remains backend-mediated and authentication-protected.
- [ ] Automated tests are added or updated where appropriate.

- Retry flows must preserve immutable snapshot rules and existing interaction-group identity.

## User Story

As a sales representative,
I want to update an interaction when information changes,
so that the current record reflects the latest information while preserving the original history.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] User can edit an authorized interaction.
- [ ] Interaction updates use `POST /api/interactions/:id`.
- [ ] Existing snapshot field values are not overwritten.
- [ ] New immutable snapshot is created.
- [ ] New snapshot keeps the same `interaction_group_id`.
- [ ] `initial_interaction_at` remains unchanged.
- [ ] `changed_at` is updated on the new snapshot.
- [ ] Previous snapshot is preserved and no interaction deletion occurs.
- [ ] Existing notes are copied to the new snapshot unless changed by the representative.

## Technical Notes

- One interaction history exists per organization + property + representative in MVP.
- Returning to the same property updates existing interaction history rather than creating a new one.
- Only owner representatives edit their interaction records; managers/admins are view-only on others.

- statuses

## User Story

As a sales representative,
I want to select a location on the map and identify its address,
so that I can record an interaction without manually entering the property address.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] User can select a location/property on the map.
- [ ] Frontend sends selected coordinates to `POST /api/properties/resolve`.
- [ ] Backend performs reverse geocoding as an internal implementation detail.
- [ ] Backend receives the geocoded address and normalizes it for matching.
- [ ] Backend checks for an existing property within the authenticated organization.
- [ ] Existing property is returned when found.
- [ ] New property is created and returned when no match exists.
- [ ] Frontend does not call the geocoding provider directly.
- [ ] Geocoding/provider errors are handled gracefully.

## Technical Notes

- Use the finalized MVP property-resolution flow: coordinates -> reverse geocoding -> normalized address -> organization-scoped lookup/create -> resolved property.
- The geocoder-returned address is the address JoeKnock uses in MVP.
- Representatives do not manually edit latitude or longitude.
- Preserve organization isolation for all property resolution behavior.

- ADR-002: Separate Properties From Interactions
